messages:
incident-bot: :rotating_light: Dedicated pool alert — valenciahealth-prod showing sustained GPU saturation (98-100%) since 1822223300. Auto-eviction prevented (pinned tenant). Thread root ts: 1822223333
sre-maya: ack. I'm paged, joining. oncall-jay, can you triage infra metrics?
oncall-jay: on it. pulling logs and queue stats now.
incident-bot: metrics snapshot: 60s gpu_util 99.1%, queue_depth 410, avg_token_latency 2.8s. Autoscaler: no spare capacity in us-west2. Pinned GPUs: 4/6 for ValenciaHealth.
eng-sam: ValenciaHealth kicked off a large overnight batch encode (clinical-triage). It's saturating pinned slots and blocking realtime requests. They requested high-prio throughput.
cust-luke: ValenciaHealth CS (Luke) here — clients reporting intermittent 504s and timeouts on triage endpoint. This is impacting cohort ingest. ETA for mitigation?
ops-anna: short-term options: 1) emergency burst +2 GPUs (temp attach) 2) route non-clinical routes to quantized variant gpt-q4_8 (possible quality drift) 3) ask Valencia to pause batch jobs. Which do we prefer?
mgr-jordan: need risk assessment. Any SLA exposure for other tenants if we burst from shared pool?
eng-sam: shared spare pool currently at 3 GPUs. Allocating +2 for 30m leaves 1 spare — acceptable risk. If we can't burst, routing to gpt-q4_8 may change outputs for clinical model (not recommended without validation).
sre-maya: operational timeline: provisioning +2 GPUs from shared pool ~5-7 minutes. If approved, do it now. Also recommend notifying Valencia to throttle batch until stabilized.
oncall-jay: /burst request valenciahealth +2 30m — filed. Waiting mgr-jordan approval.
mgr-jordan: approved. ops-anna, please proceed and log justification.
ops-anna: starting provisioning. creating vm val-burst-01 and attaching 2 x a100. ETA ~6m. Running attach script now.
incident-bot: action log:
```
1822223346 ops-anna: vm create val-burst-01
1822223368 infra: attach gpu a100-2
1822223385 pool: capacity delta +2 (temp)
```
eng-sam: once capacity shows up, I'll watch scheduling and runtimes. If queues don't drain, we'll consider increasing or redirecting lower-priority traffic.
cust-luke: ValenciaHealth on call — pausing large batch job now. Noting degraded but improving performance.
incident-bot: capacity updated +2 (1822223390). queue_depth falling -> 142.
oncall-jay: good. set 5m cadence. plan deprovision at +30m mark unless extended.
eng-sam: toggled fallback routing for ingestion pipelines to quantized model variant (non-clinical only). Clinical triage kept on original model.
sre-maya: monitoring shows 504s reduced by ~80%. GPU util decreased to 62% (1822223465). Keep close watch.
ops-anna: scheduled deprovision at 1822225133 (30m). I'll send reminder 10m before deprovision.
mgr-jordan: recorded decision and reasons in incident docs. No immediate SLA credit expected, but we will review postmortem.
sre-maya: ACTIONS: 1) Review enterprise pinned GPU limits and pre-approved burst windows 2) Add quick-validate suite for clinical model variant output 3) Add automated surge alert for long-running batch jobs
cust-luke: ValenciaHealth requests a 30-min follow-up call after closure to review root cause and request pre-approved burst for maintenance windows.
incident-bot: Incident update: queue_depth 24, gpu_util 45% — incident marked resolved (1822223950). Closing page. :white_check_mark:
